description: Synthetic English visitor descriptions, authored independently of retrieval scores. Each pair has a direct request and a paraphrase. Null means outside the current catalog. Calibration and regression data, not a held-out quality estimate.

employee-onboarding: When someone joins our company, HR collects their paperwork and arranges payroll, a laptop and access before their first day.
We need to get new starters ready for work, from signing their contract to setting up accounts and planning their induction.
expense-reports: Our employees send receipts for business trips. Finance checks the expense policy and asks their manager to approve reimbursement.
Staff pay for travel themselves and we check the receipts before paying them back through the company.
customer-support-requests: Our support team receives customer problems by email, categorises the requests and either replies or sends them to a specialist.
People contact the help desk with questions. We log a ticket, find an answer and check that the problem is resolved before closing it.
customer-onboarding-and-kyc: Before opening a bank account we collect the customer's identity documents, screen for sanctions and review the KYC risk.
Someone wants to become a bank customer. We verify who they are and run compliance checks before giving them an account.
account-reconciliation: Every month finance matches the bank statement against ledger entries and investigates transactions that do not agree.
We compare what our accounts say with what actually went through the bank, explain any differences and get the reconciliation approved.
loan-application-processing: A borrower submits a loan application. We collect income documents, check credit and affordability, then approve or reject the lending request.
Customers ask to borrow money. Our team reviews their finances, makes a lending decision and arranges signatures and the release of funds.
patient-intake-and-registration: At our clinic the front desk registers new patients, checks their insurance and referral, and collects consent forms before the visit.
Before seeing the doctor for the first time, people give us their personal details and coverage information and sign the required paperwork.
appointment-scheduling: Patients request appointments and our schedulers find an available clinician, book a slot and send reminders.
We organise the clinic diary, give urgent cases priority and offer cancelled visits to people waiting for a time with the doctor.
insurance-claims-submission: After a patient visit, our medical billing team codes the services and submits a claim to the insurer, then follows up on denials.
The clinic needs to get paid for treatments. We prepare the reimbursement paperwork, send it to the payer and reconcile their response.
claims-intake: Policyholders report accidents to us. We open an insurance claim, check the policy cover and collect evidence for the adjuster.
When an insured person suffers a loss, we record what happened, request photos and pass the case to the person handling the claim.
policy-changes: Customers ask us to update their insurance policy details. We check the requested change, refer exceptions to underwriting and issue revised documents.
An existing policyholder wants to change their cover. We review what needs updating and send them the amended insurance paperwork.
quote-preparation: A broker requests an insurance quote. We gather the risk details, check underwriting guidelines and prepare an approved price for cover.
Prospective customers tell us what they want insured and we assess the risk before sending a coverage proposal they can accept.
freight-invoice-audit: We audit carrier invoices against shipment records and agreed freight rates, and dispute overcharges before payment.
Transport companies send us bills. We compare the charges with the deliveries and our rate agreement and query any extra fees.
shipment-status-updates: Our logistics coordinators collect shipment status updates from carriers and notify customers about delivery delays.
We keep track of goods in transit, update the transport record when something moves and tell the customer when arrival plans change.
customs-documentation: For international shipments we collect trade documents, classify the goods and submit a checked customs declaration.
Before our goods cross the border, we prepare the import paperwork and tariff codes, lodge the declaration and keep the clearance records.
supplier-invoice-processing: Accounts payable matches supplier invoices to purchase orders and goods receipts, obtains approval and schedules payment.
Our suppliers send bills for materials. We verify that we ordered and received the items before getting authorisation to pay.
purchase-orders-to-suppliers: Purchasing receives material requirements, creates purchase orders for suppliers and follows them up until the goods arrive.
When production needs more materials, we choose a supplier, get the order approved and chase the delivery.
customer-order-entry: Sales support receives customer orders by email and enters them in the ERP after checking prices, credit and delivery dates.
Buyers send us orders in different formats. We type them into our sales system and confirm what we can supply and when.
returns-and-refunds: Shoppers return purchased items. We inspect the goods, approve a refund or exchange and update stock after the return.
A buyer wants their money back for an item. We register the request, check its condition when it arrives and arrange the repayment.
inventory-reconciliation: Our warehouse counts stock, compares quantities with inventory records and investigates discrepancies before posting adjustments.
We check what is physically on the shelves against the stock system and ask a supervisor to approve corrections for missing items.
retail-customer-support-requests: Shoppers contact our online store about their orders. We find the order, answer delivery questions and handle changes or complaints.
Customers use web shop chat to ask where a purchase is or change it. Our retail team looks up the order and replies.

unmatched: Please write a funny poem about a dragon who loves bananas.
How do I make a strawberry smoothie without milk?
Explain why the moon changes shape during the month.
I want a training plan to run my first marathon.
Our team edits video footage, adds subtitles and exports the finished film.
We grow tomatoes in a greenhouse and check soil moisture before watering.
Our engineers design bridge foundations and test how they withstand earthquakes.
We rehearse a theatre performance, adjust the lighting and record the music.
We review job applications, interview candidates and decide who to hire.
Our technicians diagnose a broken air conditioner, replace the faulty part and test the repair.
